name: real-codex-cli-config
head: f03fe43
plan: Add an LLM provider layer (src/core/llm): OpenRouter over fetch, plus claude and codex CLI adapters that shell out with --help feature detection, a shared spawnCli helper, config with defaults per provider, and a FakeProvider for tests. The codex adapter runs `codex exec` read-only for analysis of PR diffs and must work on a developer machine with a normal, logged-in codex install.
